title: chore(deps): bump go.opentelemetry.io/contrib to v1.46.0 line in checkout and product-catalog
author: dpacheconr
body:
## Description

Bumps `go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/*` modules used by `src/checkout` and
`src/product-catalog` to the v1.46.0/v0.71.0 release line, picking up
open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go-contrib#9429 (otelgrpc now records
`error.type` on `rpc.client.call.duration` / `rpc.server.call.duration` for
failed RPCs).

Ran `go get`/`go mod tidy` in both modules; `go build ./...` passes in each.

Fixes #3901

## Merge Requirements

- [x] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Appropriate documentation updates in [docs][]
- [ ] Appropriate Helm chart updates in [helm-charts][]

[docs]: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/demo/
[helm-charts]: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-helm-charts

Assisted-by: Claude Sonnet 5
